title: Google makes Tasks in Gemini free: it can call businesses, book appointments and pay via Google Pay

kept.claim: Google announced the Tasks in Gemini expansion on November 17, 2026.
kept.evidence: Google blog is dated Nov 17, 2026 (published_time 2026-11-17). TechCrunch was posted 11:02 AM PST, November 17, 2026.

kept.claim: The blog post announcing the update was written by Josh Woodward, Google's VP of Labs, Gemini app and AI Studio.
kept.evidence: The blog byline reads Josh Woodward, Vice President, Labs, Gemini app, and AI Studio. TechCrunch cites a blog post by Josh Woodword, VP of Gemini, and misspells his surname.

kept.claim: Tasks in Gemini is a toggle that switches the Gemini app from Chat to Task. In that mode Gemini acts on the user's behalf instead of only answering questions.
kept.evidence: Google: 'flip the home-screen toggle from Chat to Task'. TechCrunch: Tasks is a toggle that converts the chatbot into a more active helper, and users flip it from Chat to Tasks.

kept.claim: Gemini in Task mode can call businesses and book appointments for the user.
kept.evidence: Google's example has Gemini calling two dealerships, finding a free slot and adding the appointment to Google Calendar. TechCrunch: Google says the app can call businesses and book appointments on users' behalf.

kept.claim: Gemini can complete purchases using a Google Pay integration.
kept.evidence: Google: Gemini 'helped me check out using the new Google Pay integration'. TechCrunch: it can complete purchases via Google Pay.

kept.claim: Gemini can sign into websites or portals on the user's behalf. Google ties this to a Google Password Manager integration, and TechCrunch says it happens securely if prompted.
kept.evidence: Google: permission to access a utility portal 'with the new Google Password Manager integration'. TechCrunch: it can 'sign into websites securely if prompted'.

kept.claim: Tasks is now free of charge to hundreds of millions of people, using the new Gemini 4 Hydrogen model.
kept.evidence: Google: 'rolling out free of charge for hundreds of millions of people... using our new Gemini 4 Hydrogen model'. TechCrunch: now making the feature available for free to hundreds of millions of people using the Gemini 4 Hydrogen model.

kept.claim: Users can also text Gemini to give it tasks. Google says this is on Android or iOS via Settings > Channels > Text with Gemini, with a verified phone number. The RCS text integration needs a US phone number with an eligible mobile carrier.
kept.evidence: Google lists the setup steps and the footnote on US carriers. TechCrunch: users can send texts to Gemini to give it commands.

kept.claim: The feature is older than the Nov 17 expansion. It was announced at Google I/O 2026 in May as Gemini Spark, a 24/7 personal agent. TechCrunch says it first went to select testers and later to U.S. Google AI Ultra subscribers.
kept.evidence: TechCrunch: 'initially launched to select testers back in May as Gemini Spark' and expanded to U.S. subscribers of Google AI Ultra. 9to5Google: 'Announced at I/O 2026 in May' and says 'Task' is Gemini Spark.

kept.claim: Gemini Spark was folded into the main Gemini app as 'Task' mode. 9to5Google reported the redesign on Oct 12, 2026, adding Chat and Task buttons above the prompt box.
kept.evidence: TechCrunch: Gemini Spark 'eventually became' Task Mode. 9to5Google, Oct 12 2026: Google is combining Spark with the main chat experience, and 'Task' is Gemini Spark.

dropped.claim: The free rollout covers six countries: the U.S., Japan, Korea, Canada, Australia, and India.
dropped.evidence: Google blog names the six countries. TechCrunch does not list countries.

dropped.claim: A set of advanced features is rolling out starting in the U.S.
dropped.evidence: Google: 'We're also rolling out a set of advanced features, starting in the U.S.' TechCrunch does not say this.

dropped.claim: Users can forward emails to gemini@google.com, starting in the U.S.
dropped.evidence: Google: 'Starting in the U.S., you can also forward emails to gemini@google.com'.

dropped.claim: TechCrunch says users can also call the app to give it commands. Google's post does not say this.
dropped.evidence: TechCrunch: 'Users can also send texts to Gemini or call the app to give it commands.'

dropped.claim: Before the Nov 17 expansion, Gemini Spark required an AI Pro or AI Ultra subscription. This is 9to5Google's Oct 12 report. TechCrunch only mentions Ultra subscribers.
dropped.evidence: 9to5Google: 'Gemini Spark requires an AI Pro or AI Ultra subscription.' TechCrunch mentions only the Ultra tier.

dropped.claim: On calls, Gemini discloses right away that it is an AI. Businesses can opt out, and Gemini won't give out payment or private account info unless the user says so.
dropped.evidence: Google blog (Woodward's dealership example and opt-out link).

dropped.claim: Calling through Gemini is not currently available in Indiana, Louisiana, Minnesota, Montana, and Nebraska.

Gemini uses the Agent Payments Protocol (AP2) for purchases. Google says it is working with American Express (coming soon), Mastercard and Visa on digital tokens, and users can set a hard spending cap upfront.
Gemini is designed to ask for confirmation or pre-approval before clicking 'Buy'. Users can set routine actions to 'Always allow'.
Each task runs in a hardware-isolated virtual machine dedicated to the user's account, using Google Cloud's Agent Compute Engine.
dropped.evidence: Google blog: 'hardware-isolated virtual machine that's dedicated to your account and never shared with other users'.

dropped.claim: Google says it has not eliminated all mistakes. On some sites Gemini may hand the screen back to the user to click the final button.
dropped.evidence: Google blog: 'we haven't eliminated all of them'; Gemini 'can make it most of the way through and then hand the screen back to you'.
